english: Once upon a time, there was a mother duck.

chinese: 其中五只小鸭子又小又黄，
english: Five of the ducklings were small and yellow,

chinese: 但最后一只鸭子却又大又灰。
english: but the last duckling was big and grey.

chinese: “他长得不像我们！多么丑的一只鸭子！”
english: “He doesn’t look like us! What an ugly duckling!”

chinese: 在河里，丑小鸭游得很好，
english: At the river, the ugly duckling swam well,

chinese: 就像所有其他小鸭子一样。
english: just like all the other ducklings.

chinese: 但其他小鸭子仍然嘲笑他，叫他走开。
english: But the other ducklings still laughed at him and told him to go away.

chinese: 这让可怜的丑小鸭非常伤心，
english: It made the poor duckling very sad,

chinese: 于是他决定去寻找一个新家。
english: so he decided to search for a new home.
